item: Class ability icons - Mage + Priest (ART-RESUME NEXT ITEM 5)
status: candidate for Skyy's review; NOT committed, NOT wired in, NOT seen in game

defaults_used.frame: round dark slate frame band with a class-colour rim (bevelled, top lit)
defaults_used.background: dark field tinted toward the class colour (Mage navy #26335e -> #0e1226, Priest warm umber #43381e -> #15100c, radial)

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Pick a spot within 25 blocks; after 1 s a meteor hits a 4-block area for 3.0 H. Shapes: Comet (sprint), Under Me (mid-air), Meteor on Me (crouch).
files.icon_shows: a faceted burning rock diving toward the lower left with a three-tongued fire trail (violet arcane fringe at the tail) and embers

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Dome placed where you look (up to 8 blocks) for 12 s; inside it, damage drains Mana instead of Health (1 Mana per 2 HP). Crouch = Pocket Dome on you.
files.icon_shows: a glassy blue hex-panel dome on a rune ring with a glowing mana crystal inside

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Freeze enemies within 5 blocks for 2 s (a hit breaks it after 1 s), then Chill 3 s; 1.0 H. Crouch = Deep Freeze.
files.icon_shows: a six-armed ice crystal (snowflake) with a hex gem core and six ice shards bursting outward between the arms

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: 12 stars fall over 3 s on a 6-block area you aim at, each 0.3 H. Crouch = Star Shower on you.
files.icon_shows: three pale starlight stars (big, medium, small) falling toward the lower left with violet streak trails

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Channel a 20-block beam for up to 3 s that ramps 1x -> 3x (0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 H per second). Crouch = Focused Beam.
files.icon_shows: a violet orb in a gold 4-prong cradle firing a beam of light that widens as it goes (the ramp), one rune ring round it

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Instant heal of 25% max Health (Priest 30%) for everyone within 9 blocks + a heal over time of 40% of it over 4 s. Crouch = Kneel.
files.icon_shows: a bold gold healing cross with flared ends and an ivory inset, bursting a 12-ray sunburst

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: A 6-block bubble where you look (up to 8 blocks) for 12 s; its HP = 100% of your max Health; 4 heal pulses as it drops to 75 / 50 / 25 / 0%. Crouch = Around Me.
files.icon_shows: a translucent soul-cyan bubble with a highlight streak round a gold-rimmed heater shield with a soul gem

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Passive 30-block aura: a party member (or you) who would die survives at 30% Health if you have the Mana; per-player cooldown 12 s, doubling each save (12, 24, 48 ...).
files.icon_shows: spread angel wings and a gold halo round a glowing cyan soul flame (the guardian angel that catches a falling ally)

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Holy zone placed under you for 12 s, 8 blocks: allies heal 5% max Health per second and take 10% less damage. Crouch = Inner Sanctum.
files.icon_shows: a pointed (gothic) arch of ivory stone with a soul-gem keystone, holy light filling the doorway, standing in a glowing gold rune circle on the ground

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: 75% heal on the lowest ally within 30 blocks, then chains to the next lowest, -15 per jump (75 / 60 / 45 / 30 / 15); party first, the Priest counts as party.
files.icon_shows: a big haloed rose heart with a heal plus, chaining golden light bolts to a smaller and then a smallest heart (the heal drops each jump)

files.what: review sheet for Skyy: every icon at 4x / 2x / 64 / 32 px, grouped by class with the class colour swatch, plus a dark HUD strip
